title: Murder Drones
desc: Set on a frozen exoplanet where rogue Worker Drones fight for survival against lethal Disassembly Drones. When the rebellious Uzi teams up with the polite but deadly N, they uncover deep-seated conspiracies and a terrifying power that defies their programming. A dark, sci-fi action-comedy about robots, trauma, and the end of the world.
author: GLITCH
